description: Every guarantee AgenticTeam makes, the layer that backs it, the test that proves it, and its known bypass. docs/architecture.md renders this file (agentic_team.py docs --write).

layers.cli: The state CLI refuses the transition (exit 1/2/3).
layers.harness: Harness configuration or the guard hook refuses the tool call (Claude Code, Codex; OpenCode/Gemini/Copilot/Cursor/Factory/Kiro/Qwen/Junie where their permission fields apply).
layers.tamper-evident: Not prevented, but detected afterwards by doctor or audit verify.
layers.instruction: Only the role prompts and protocols ask for it.

guarantees.statement: Human decisions (approve, reject, resolve, waive, cancel, reopen, promote, human fusion-close) need the owner token; an edited state.json approves nothing.
guarantees.bypass: An agent that reads the token from ~/.agentic-team (blocked by harness rules; only an OS sandbox makes it impossible).

guarantees.statement: A stage exits only with its exit contract met (artifacts without template markers, AC traceability, typed evidence, VERIFICATION verdict lines), no pending checkpoint, and finished specialists.
guarantees.bypass: A human waiver (stage-exit:<stage>:<check>); artifact content quality is judged by reviewers, not the CLI.

guarantees.statement: The verifier is not a builder: --verifies tasks refuse their builders and VERIFICATION.md's Verifier may not be a 04_build claimant.
guarantees.bypass: Agent identity is self-declared: an agent could claim under another role id.

guarantees.statement: Task risk comes from the declared action and target, raised by sensitive paths and operating-on-the-world wording; only the human lowers it.
guarantees.bypass: A task declared as a benign action that later runs a deploy command; G05 catches the command where hooks exist.

guarantees.statement: Commands matching an R3/R4 command rule (deploys, publishes, force pushes, infrastructure apply, global installs) run only inside a claimed task of that action with a human-approved risk checkpoint.
guarantees.bypass: Harnesses without a hook (Pi, generic, and the six newer targets) and deliberately obfuscated commands.

guarantees.statement: Agents never read or write ~/.agentic-team (owner tokens, key bindings, ledger).
guarantees.bypass: A subprocess that opens the file indirectly without naming the path, and harnesses without the guard hook; only an OS sandbox (macOS/Linux/WSL2) prevents it.

guarantees.statement: Only the CLI writes state.json, events.jsonl, and _evidence/.
guarantees.bypass: Edits in harnesses without hooks; detected by doctor/audit verify (event hash chain, owner-key binding).

guarantees.statement: Fusion councils run in phase order, without resubmission, with moderator, verifier, and contributors independent.
guarantees.bypass: None within the CLI.

guarantees.statement: Fusion proposals stay private until every contributor has submitted, and cannot be rewritten after submission.
guarantees.bypass: Reading other proposals in harnesses without the guard hook; rewrites are caught at reveal only when submitted with --file.

guarantees.statement: Completion evidence is typed and checked: files exist and are hashed, exec records carry exit codes, commits resolve; build and remediation tasks by writing roles must declare an acceptance check, and complete runs every check lacking a passing record at the current HEAD and refuses while one fails.
guarantees.bypass: Note-only evidence remains allowed for inspection and documentation tasks; a task recorded before checks were required completes only with the human's checks:<task> waiver; the check command itself is what the task author declared.

guarantees.statement: Claims respect ownership, the current stage, owned-path overlap, and the concurrency cap.
guarantees.bypass: Editing files outside the claimed paths is not detected (instruction).

guarantees.statement: Review roles never edit project source.
guarantees.bypass: Shell commands that write files, and every harness other than Claude Code.

guarantees.statement: Budgets open a checkpoint at the warning threshold and stop the command that would exceed them; a per-run --budget only tightens the policy's ceiling.
guarantees.bypass: Token and USD ceilings see what agents report and what the owner side meters from harness transcripts (G19); a harness that writes no transcript is unmetered.

guarantees.statement: A rejection blocks the run until the human resolves it; exhausted retries in hitl block until the human reopens or cancels.
guarantees.bypass: None within the CLI.

guarantees.statement: Playbook checks become proven only through the human's promote.
guarantees.bypass: Playbooks are ordinary files: an agent can edit the status text directly (visible in review and the ledger has no record).

guarantees.statement: The seven hard human gates (R3/R4 actions) hold in every autonomy profile, unattended included; the release-stage exit is a human checkpoint in autonomous, supervised, and hitl, and executable only under unattended for a run with no task above R1.
guarantees.bypass: An action taken without any declared task in a harness without hooks; keep production credentials out of agent environments.

guarantees.statement: A task that fails the same way twice stops retrying; only the human reopens it.
guarantees.bypass: Failure reasons worded differently each time produce different signatures.

guarantees.statement: Verification is pinned to the code being released: Verified-SHA must equal the current HEAD when 05_verify exits, and 06_release cannot exit while HEAD differs from the verified commit.
guarantees.bypass: Projects without git history (Verified-SHA: none); uncommitted edits do not move HEAD; the human's stage-exit:06_release:verified-head waiver.

guarantees.statement: Autonomous, supervised, and unattended runs start only with a token or USD ceiling, and the ceiling counts the larger of agent-reported usage and usage metered from the harness transcript by the owner side (usage --transcript, signed into the ledger).
guarantees.bypass: Metering depends on whoever launched the session running usage with the transcript; the figures are the harness's client-side estimate.

guarantees.statement: Under unattended, 06_release exits without a human checkpoint only when the exit contract passes (verified-head included), every completed build and verify task has a passing exec record for each declared check, no task in the run is above R1 (one R2+ task puts the human checkpoint back), RELEASE.md is complete and a rollback-test task by release-manager or devops-engineer passed its declared rollback command at the current HEAD, and no budget checkpoint is pending; release_gate executable is refused on every other profile, and policies.local.json can set it back to human.
guarantees.bypass: The checks and the rollback command are what the task authors declared; work declared as a benign action (G04's bypass) looks low-risk; the human's stage-exit:06_release:<check> waivers cover the exit contract; actions taken without a task are invisible, as everywhere.

guarantees.statement: A worker started with its own AGENTIC_TEAM_HOME sees human decisions only through the verification view the owner side exports (binding and ledger, no token); a v3 run with neither the home binding nor a view counts no decision in state.json and refuses gated commands.
guarantees.bypass: The view is only as trustworthy as the worker's inability to write it; on the same OS user without isolation a worker could edit it, which the owner's audit verify (unsigned records) and the export digest detect afterwards.

guarantees.statement: Once a token or USD ceiling is spent, claim and exec refuse new work until the human waives budget:<metric>, while status, metering, fail, recover-leases and human decisions keep working; usage figures that are not finite or are negative are refused.
guarantees.bypass: Spend inside a running harness session is metered only after the session ends; the ceiling stops the next command, not the session.
